title: Senior Backend-Entwickler – Agents (100% Remote)
description:
Wir suchen Senior Developer, die in unserem vollständig remoten Team an unseren Agenten arbeiten. Wenn du Komplexität magst und willst, dass deine Arbeit wirklich etwas bewegt, passt du zu uns.

Über uns
Hausverwalter.ai ist eine All-in-One-Plattform für Hausverwaltungen, mit Funktionen wie Inbox, CRM, Dokumenten, Telefonie, Video Calls, Team Chat und KI-Agenten. Unsere Mission ist es, alles zu automatisieren, was ein Hausverwalter tut.

Über die Rolle
Unsere Plattform ist von Tag eins an agentisch gedacht. Bevor wir überhaupt die UI geplant haben, haben wir geplant, wie Agenten mit der Software arbeiten. Denk dran – unser Ziel ist, die ganze Branche zu automatisieren, und das meinen wir ernst.
Heute gibt es für fast alles, was der Nutzer in der UI machen kann, ein Agenten-Tool, und der Co-Pilot (der tägliche Assistent des Nutzers) kann alles für ihn übernehmen, sogar den Dark Mode an- und ausschalten.
Aber der Co-Pilot ist erst der Anfang. Die eigentliche Herausforderung sind die autonomen Agenten. Dazu unten mehr.

Woran du arbeiten wirst

  • Inbox-Agents: Autonome Agenten, die anspringen, sobald in einem Ticket etwas Neues passiert. Kunden trainieren sie selbst ODER nehmen einfach eine der Vorlagen, die du für sie baust. Diese Agenten können heute schon komplette komplexe Abläufe allein übernehmen und sind einer der Hauptgründe, warum sich Kunden für unsere Software interessieren. Aber wann sollte ein Agent an einen Menschen abgeben, statt selbst zu Ende zu machen? Wie stellen wir sicher, dass er sich an den Prozess hält? Das sind deine Fragen.

  • Harness Engineering: Der Agent hat über 100 Tools. Aber er muss eine Anfrage so verstehen, wie ein Hausverwalter sie versteht, und nicht so, wie die Begriffe außerhalb der Branche klingen. Was gehört in den System Prompt, was in Skills?

  • Knowledge Base: Unsere Plattform hat eine eigene Knowledge Base, ähnlich wie Notion. Komplett selbst gebaut und gedacht als kollektives Gehirn des Unternehmens. Aber sollte die KI auch von selbst „lernen"? Und wenn ja, wann? Und wie machen wir die Suche in der Knowledge Base besser — über bessere Tools, System Prompts oder Skills?

  • Voice-Agents: Dieselben Agenten, nur am Telefon — auf LiveKit gebaut, die Anrufe genauso abwickeln wie unsere Text-Agenten Tickets.

  • LLM Infrastructure. Das richtige Modell für die jeweilige Aufgabe wählen, per Caching und Streaming die Latenz drücken, bei Provider-Ausfällen sauber neu versuchen, Context kompakt halten, die RAG-Suche optimieren, Usage über alle Provider tracken, Kosten senken und mit Evals prüfen, was wirklich besser ist.

Ihre Aufgaben

Die Rolle ist bewusst breit – du arbeitest über den gesamten Stack und hast echten Gestaltungsspielraum:

  • Du betreibst und entwickelst unsere Multi-Cloud-Plattform weiter – Azure AKS und Hetzner Cloud (k3s) – und konsolidierst schrittweise unsere bestehende On-Prem-Umgebung.

BeamNG is an independent game & software development studio, established in 2013 in Bremen, Germany. We are an international, remote-first team of almost 90 people. Our development focuses on state-of-the-art soft-body physics vehicle simulation, currently available as an early access videogame - BeamNG.drive, and as a stand-alone research platform - BeamNG.tech

title: Head of Marketing
description:
About Keyrock

Since 2017, Keyrock has been a change-maker in digital assets. We're a global, remote-first team of 200+ people across 40+ nationalities, with hubs in Brussels, London, Paris and New York.

We provide liquidity across 80+ centralized and decentralized exchanges - a position cemented by our Series C, led by SC Ventures. Today we run a full spectrum of capital markets businesses across centralized and on-chain venues: market making, high-frequency trading, options, OTC, DeFi trading desks, advisory, and asset management.

We're building toward the agentic investment banking capabilities for the era of digital finance. A proprietary agentic layer runs the mechanics of the market, so our people can focus on the work code cannot do: the deal, the relationship, and the judgement.

 

We're not just envisioning the future of finance - we're building it.

The Opportunity

We are hiring a Head of Marketing to take full ownership of our marketing strategy, rebrand Keyrock and reposition us as the market evolves from crypto-native to institutional, merging with traditional finance.

This is not a maintenance role. It is a transformation mandate with full discretionary decision-making on how to implement our commercial strategy. You will work as a close strategic partner to the CCO, operating almost as co-marketeers.

The team is lean by design: 2-3 direct reports plus heavy use of AI and agentic tooling. We are looking for someone who inspires and sets direction, not someone who runs campaigns. Operational execution will increasingly be handled by AI agents.

What You Will Do

  • Own and execute the complete rebrand and repositioning of Keyrock in the market

  • Define and drive the marketing strategy across institutional and crypto-native audiences

  • Build a premium, forward-looking brand identity. Think distinctive, audacious, credible to both institutional allocators and crypto-native operators

  • Push information into the market in ways that make people pay attention and take Keyrock seriously

  • Partner closely with the CCO and commercial team to drive measurable commercial impact

  • Build and lead a small, high-impact team augmented by AI tooling

  • Shape how Keyrock is perceived as the industry converges with traditional finance

title: AI Developer (m/w/d)
description:
Metanoia IT entwickelt Software und skalierbare SaaS-Lösungen für eine ausgewählte Zahl etablierter Stammkunden – SaaS- und Mittelstandsfirmen mit eigener Software, Ausgründungen und eigenen Projekten. Wir arbeiten AI-nativ und bringen KI genau dort ins Produkt, wo sie echten Mehrwert schafft.

Aufgaben

Du verantwortest LLM-basierte Features von Anfang bis Ende – vom Prompt bis zu dem, was am Ende beim Nutzer ankommt – und es ist dir nicht egal, ob der Output am Ende wirklich taugt. Du bringst Ideen schnell in einen funktionierenden Zustand, statt auf die perfekte Spezifikation zu warten, und bleibst dran, bis sie auch in Produktion halten.

  • Du baust produktnahe Features über den gesamten Stack – mit klarer Tendenz zum Ausliefern und Iterieren statt zum ewigen Feinschliff.
  • Du arbeitest an unserer Multi-LLM-Pipeline und triffst bewusste Entscheidungen bei Modellwahl, Kosten und Latenz.
  • Du baust Eval-Loops gegen echten Output: Baseline definieren, iterieren und belegen können, was sich messbar verbessert hat.
  • Du verantwortest die Nachvollziehbarkeit unserer LLM-Systeme – Tracing pro Schritt und Prompt-Provenance – sodass sich ein schlechter Output bis zu dem Call zurückverfolgen lässt, der ihn erzeugt hat.
  • Du entwirfst Human-in-the-Loop-Agent-Workflows: Agenten schlagen vor, der Mensch entscheidet. Nichts geht autonom live.
  • Du prototypst schnell, härtest danach ab und bringst deine eigene Arbeit in Produktion – inklusive Konfiguration, Feature Flags und geplanten Jobs.
  • Du bringst eigene Produktideen ein, statt nur Tickets abzuarbeiten.

Qualifikation

  • Nachweisbares Produktgespür und Tempo: Du lieferst funktionierende Dinge und triffst pragmatische Trade-offs.
  • AI-natives Arbeiten im Alltag (Claude, Cursor) als echter Workflow, nicht als Demo.Praktische Erfahrung mit LLM-Orchestrierung (Function Calling, Agenten, Evaluation).
  • Du hast LLM-Verhalten in Produktion getracet und damit einen echten Bug gefunden.
  • Du kannst erklären, wann eine deterministische Pipeline die bessere Wahl ist als ein Agent.
  • Die Bereitschaft, das Deployment deiner eigenen Arbeit zu verantworten.
  • Fließendes Deutsch.

Benefits

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern und echter Einfluss auf Produkt und Kultur
  • Ein AI-natives Arbeitsumfeld mit erstklassigen Tools
  • Remote Arbeit
  • Flache Hierarchien, kurze Wege und schnelle Entscheidungen

Mit mehr als 250 Mates in Berlin, Hamburg, Köln und Remote entwickeln wir Social-First-Strategien, produzieren Content in eigenen Studios, arbeiten eng mit Creator:innen zusammen und steuern Kampagnen datengetrieben über unsere eigene Technologie. Unsere Kund:innen sind einige der bekanntesten Marken der Welt – von Lifestyle über FMCG bis hin zu Tech.

Als Teil von SAMY, einem globalen Agenturnetzwerk für Social Media und Creator Marketing, sind wir mit über 970 Expert:innen an 20 Standorten vernetzt. Das eröffnet internationale Perspektiven, Projekte in rund 55 Märkten und die Möglichkeit, dich weit über Ländergrenzen hinweg weiterzuentwickeln.

DEINE ROLLE

Wir bauen für einen unserer Hero Accounts eine Creative Unit auf – als Mid-Level Creative Concept/Copy bist du Teil dieses Teams und übernimmst zunehmend eigenständig Verantwortung für Konzeption und Copy. Du entwickelst nicht nur einzelne Postings, sondern lernst, Briefs in tragfähige Ideen und Kampagnenlogiken zu übersetzen – eng begleitet von deinem Senior und deinem Creative Lead. Social-First-Erfahrung ist von Vorteil, aber kein Muss: Auch mit einem eher klassischen Kreativ-Background bist du bei uns richtig.

  • Du entwickelst eigenständig Konzepte und Copy für einzelne Formate und Themen und bringst dich bei größeren Kampagnenideen aktiv mit ein – in enger Abstimmung mit Senior und Creative Lead
  • Du schreibst Skripte und Copy für unterschiedliche Formate und Plattformen und achtest dabei auf Ton und Konsistenz innerhalb der jeweiligen Brand-Identity
  • Du bereitest deine Ideen in überzeugende Präsentationsform auf und stellst sie intern vor, mit wachsender Sicherheit auch vor Kund:innen
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Senior Creatives, Junior-Kolleg:innen und weiteren Departments innerhalb der Agentur zusammen und holst dir aktiv Feedback ein
  • Du bringst dich in die Weiterentwicklung des Accounts ein, erkennst Trends und Themen und schlägst eigenständig Anknüpfungspunkte für den Kunden vor
  • Du übernimmst zunehmend Verantwortung für kleinere Projekte oder Teilstrecken größerer Kampagnen

description:
Dandy is transforming the massive and antiquated dental industry—an industry worth over $400B. We’re looking for a highly consultative Field Trainer in the Bristol metro area to lead impactful, in-person training that accelerates early clinical success with Dandy’s digital dentistry solutions. title: Product Manager (FTC)
Special Projects Lead - Category Expansion
description:
Can you help us fix the world's most broken supply chain?

The fashion industry produces over 100 billion garments a year. 60% end up in landfill, not because people don't want these clothes, but because the supply chain for getting secondhand fashion from donation to resale is completely offline, manual and broken.

Fleek is fixing this. Our mission is to make secondhand the first choice. We're building the infrastructure powering the global secondhand clothing trade, through a B2B marketplace and the AI systems digitising the supply chain behind it.

Through Fleek, vintage stores, online resellers and retail buyers source graded secondhand inventory directly from wholesalers and rag houses across multiple countries. Our key enabler is FleekSort, an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion that can grade, price and categorise items with just a photo. Turning what has historically been an opaque and manual trade into a structured, searchable and tradable global inventory layer.

Since 2022, we've saved 9 million items from landfill while tripling in size year-on-year. We're backed by some of the world's best investors, including a16z, Y Combinator and HV Capital, alongside world-class angels who helped build Depop, Shopify, and Postmates.

Today, we serve thousands of resellers and retailers across the UK, Europe and the US. With the secondhand fashion market projected to reach $350B by 2027, Fleek is building the AI-native operational and financial backbone for secondhand commerce globally.

We're looking for people who want to build something that matters and move fast doing it. Sounds good? Keep reading.

About the Role

We're hiring a Special Projects Lead into our Commercial team to own Fleek's bets. These are new business lines that could each add £5M+ in GMV but have no playbook yet. These bets are too important to be anyone's second priority and too heavy to bolt onto an existing role, because each one cuts across supply, operations, CX and commercial. So this is a dedicated seat. You take a bet from thesis to signed deal to live pilot to proven economics. You make the call to double down or kill it. Then you hand it off and pick up the next one.

This is a solo seat with no team and no playbook. You'll have real ownership from day one and work directly with the founders. It's a founder-operator role, not a sales or BD role. It's also explicitly an individual contributor seat rather than a VP or Director title, and will suit an operator a few jobs into their career who has personally carried a number and wants scope they'd struggle to get anywhere else.

title: Security Advocate | AI AppSec
description:
About Escape


Escape secures the code-to-cloud attack surface that covers DAST, ASM and AI Pentesting. Our platform continuously maps and tests every asset exposed to the internet, including undocumented APIs and endpoints, with automated AI penetration testing and DAST running at the pace of modern development teams.

 

With a team of 45+ people based across Paris, Amsterdam, Hawaii, Boston, and New York, Escape is Series A funded and rapidly growing. We are building a world-class team to help organizations protect what matters most.

 

The Role


As a Security Advocate at Escape, you will bridge the gap between our security technology and the engineering community. You will champion security best practices, promote our platform, and empower developers, security teams, and customers to take proactive approaches to security.

Our users and customers are deeply technical: Security Engineers, AppSec teams, developers, security researchers and CISOs. We’re looking for someone who can speak their language and become one of the technical voices of Escape in the security community.

Your mission: demystify complex security issues, contribute to our product’s visibility, and build lasting relationships with technical communities. Through talks, live demos, content creation, and customer engagement, you’ll be the voice of Escape’s security expertise and a trusted partner for our users.

Why We’re Hiring

Some of the best conversations in cybersecurity don't start with a sales pitch. They start with an interesting vulnerability, a technical demo, a GitHub project, a conference talk, a strong opinion or a very good security meme.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Serve as a subject matter expert on application and cloud security, representing Escape at industry events, conferences, and webinars

  • Create and deliver engaging content: blogs, videos, presentations, and technical documentation that educates and inspires

  • Work directly with customers to understand their challenges, provide best practice guidance, and gather feedback for product improvement

  • Build relationships with developer, security, and DevSecOps communities to amplify Escape’s message

  • Stay informed on security threats, trends, and best practices, sharing insights intern

title: Head of Marketing (Director)
description:
About Keyrock

Since 2017, Keyrock has been a change-maker in digital assets. We're a global, remote-first team of 200+ people across 40+ nationalities, with hubs in Brussels, London, Paris and New York.

We provide liquidity across 80+ centralized and decentralized exchanges - a position cemented by our Series C, led by SC Ventures. Today we run a full spectrum of capital markets businesses across centralized and on-chain venues: market making, high-frequency trading, options, OTC, DeFi trading desks, advisory, and asset management.

We're building toward the agentic investment banking capabilities for the era of digital finance. A proprietary agentic layer runs the mechanics of the market, so our people can focus on the work code cannot do: the deal, the relationship, and the judgement.

 

We're not just envisioning the future of finance - we're building it.

The Opportunity

We are hiring a Head of Marketing to take full ownership of our marketing strategy, rebrand Keyrock and reposition us as the market evolves from crypto-native to institutional, merging with traditional finance.

This is not a maintenance role. It is a transformation mandate with full discretionary decision-making on how to implement our commercial strategy. You will work as a close strategic partner to the CCO, operating almost as co-marketeers.

The team is lean by design: 2-3 direct reports plus heavy use of AI and agentic tooling. We are looking for someone who inspires and sets direction, not someone who runs campaigns. Operational execution will increasingly be handled by AI agents.

What You Will Do

  • Own and execute the complete rebrand and repositioning of Keyrock in the market

  • Define and drive the marketing strategy across institutional and crypto-native audiences

  • Build a premium, forward-looking brand identity. Think distinctive, audacious, credible to both institutional allocators and crypto-native operators

  • Push information into the market in ways that make people pay attention and take Keyrock seriously

  • Partner closely with the CCO and commercial team to drive measurable commercial impact

  • Build and lead a small, high-impact team augmented by AI tooling

  • Shape how Keyrock is perceived as the industry converges with traditional finance

title: Avionics Software Engineer
Principal Product Manager- Conversational AI
description:
About the Role
HTS Assist is Hopper's agentic AI assistant for travel, resolving real customer issues like flight changes, cancellations, refunds, and bookings over chat and voice for some of the largest travel brands and enterprises in the world. As Principal Product Manager, you will own the customer-facing agent end to end: the conversations, the interface, and the experience our partners put in front of millions of travelers. This is a deliberately design-leaning role, and you will be the day-to-day design decision-maker, shaping flows and interfaces directly in close partnership with partner design teams and our in-house designer.

What would your day-to-day look like

  • Own the roadmap for the customer-facing conversational agent across chat and voice, from intent coverage and conversation design to the interfaces partners embed in their apps and websites

  • Engage enterprise partners through discovery, requirement shaping, and launch decisions, translating partner asks into product choices that keep one product serving many partners

  • Partner with Partner Solutions on implementation and onboarding

  • Drive design daily, working hands-on in Figma to produce flows and wireframes, and partner with design on high-fidelity and production assets

  • Build working prototypes using AI coding tools where they beat a written spec, to test conversation flows and interface ideas

  • Define and defend quality bars with the evaluation team, covering resolution rate, containment, escalation correctness, and conversation quality

  • Specify agent behavior in detail, including resolution, tone, escalation policy, guardrails, and edge cases, and iterate from production conversation data

  • Stay close to GTM, Partner Solutions, and Success teams, feeding what the field learns back into the roadmap

An ideal candidate has

title: Senior Product Designer | 7taps
description:
About 7taps

7taps is a training delivery platform built for the way people actually absorb information: short, sharp, and on-the-go. Enterprise teams use it to reach their whole workforce and prove the training got done. Its customers are major enterprises like Amazon and Tesla: organizations where people need to learn something, retain it, and actually apply it.

The product started as a simple flashcard tool and has evolved into a full infrastructure layer for corporate training: multi-channel delivery (SMS, WhatsApp, Teams, Slack, email, QR), course creation, and completion analytics that show exactly who finished, without forcing anyone to log in.

The design team is small and strong. You'd be the fourth designer, embedded directly in the product process.

The platform is web-only, and the design problem is two-sided. On one side, admins running campaigns for tens of thousands of employees, with bulk operations and permissions where one wrong click matters. On the other, the people taking those courses. They're at office desks, on warehouse floors, out in the field. Some live in software all day, some barely touch it. Both sides have to work.

What you are expected to do:

  • Own product design end-to-end: from early concept to shipped feature with a high degree of autonomy.

  • Design systems and flows: coherent product architecture across a complex multi-sided platform (course creators, learners, admins, analytics).

  • Collaborate closely with engineers and the broader team to define and validate product hypotheses.

  • Work within an existing design system and help it evolve.

  • Move fast: the team pivots frequently, tests hypotheses fast, and discards what doesn't work — you'll be part of that rhythm.

  • Communicate your thinking clearly in synchronous settings: be the person in the call who can sketch a solution on the fly, take feedback, and iterate immediately.

What you need to succeed:

  • You think in systems and design coherent experiences, finding the shortest path to the right structure.

  • You drive tasks to completion on your own, without hand-holding.

  • You communicate ideas and trade-offs clearly, so non-designers can follow your thinking.

  • You thrive in a fast hypothesis-test-discard cadence and stay steady when work gets shelved.

title: Senior Product Manager: Recall
description:
About Us

Constructor powers product search and discovery for some of the largest retailers in the world. We serve billions of requests every week, and you’ve probably seen our results somewhere and used our product without knowing it. We differentiate ourselves by focusing on metrics over features, and reinventing search and discovery from the ground up as a machine learning challenge with the specific goal of improving metrics like revenue. We’re approximately doubling year over year despite the market slowing down and have customers in every eCommerce vertical. We’re a passionate team of technologists who love solving problems and want to make our customers’ and coworkers’ lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they think is best can lead to great things.

Job Summary

We’re looking for a highly technical, systems-minded Senior Product Manager to lead two critical search intelligence teams: Machine Learning & Recall and Query. Search at Constructor is fundamentally an ML challenge, and this role sits at the absolute entry point of our discovery pipeline, right where shopper intent meets candidate retrieval.

In this role, you will bridge the Query team (understanding what a shopper means across intent, entities, and language) with the Machine Learning & Recall team (retrieving the exact right set of candidate products across massive catalogs). You will define strategy across both domains, balancing state-of-the-art techniques, such as vector search, semantic parsing, dense embeddings, and LLM-assisted query interpretation, with low-latency production execution. You won’t be measured on shipping features for the sake of it; you’ll be measured on candidate quality, query accuracy, and driving business outcomes like conversion rate, search-attributed revenue, and revenue per visit.

What You’ll Do

  • Set a unified roadmap: Define the multi-quarter vision and strategy across both the Machine Learning & Recall and Query teams, ensuring query understanding and candidate generation evolve hand-in-hand.

description:

title: Area Sales Manager Süddeutschland (all genders) Schlauchtechnik
description:
Für ein etabliertes, familiengeführtes Unternehmen aus der industriellen Schlauchsystemtechnik suchen wir eine vertriebsstarke Persönlichkeit für den Ausbau eines definierten Vertriebsgebiets in Süddeutschland (Bayern oder Baden-Württemberg).

Aufgaben

  • Sie entwickeln Hand in Hand mit der Vertriebsleitung Strategien zur Weiterentwicklung Ihres Vertriebsgebiets und setzen diese eigenverantwortlich um.
  • Sie verantworten sowohl die Gewinnung von Neukunden (etwa 40%) als auch die Betreuung von Bestandskunden.
  • Sie begleiten Ihre Kunden fachlich während des gesamten Projektverlaufs von der ersten Anfrage über die technische und kaufmännische Ausarbeitung bis zum Abschluss.
  • Sie stimmen sich eng mit dem Innendienst und den technischen Fachbereichen ab, um tragfähige Lösungen sicherzustellen.
  • Sie führen Vertragsverhandlungen durch.

Qualifikation

  • Sie verfügen über eine technische oder kaufmännische Ausbildung, gerne mit entsprechender Weiterbildung, z.B. zum staatlich geprüften Techniker o.Ä.
  • Sie konnten bereits Erfahrung im Verkauf erklärungsbedürftiger Produkte in einem technischen Umfeld sammeln, idealerweise im Produktbereich von Schläuchen, Armaturen oder Verbindungstechnik.
  • Sie verfügen über eine vertriebs- und lösungsorientierte Persönlichkeit, die unternehmerisch denkt und Verantwortung für Ergebnisse übernimmt.
  • Sie zeichnen sich durch eine strukturierte, eigenständige und ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise aus.
  • Sie wohnen im Vertriebsgebiet (Bayern oder Baden-Württemberg) und bringen die Bereitschaft zu beruflichen Reisen innerhalb Ihres Gebiets mit.

Benefits

  • Gehaltspaket zwischen 60.000 und 80.000 EUR p.a.
  • Inhabergeführtes etabliertes Unternehmen
  • Hohe Eigenverantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Dienstwagen, auch zur privaten Nutzung
  • Raum für fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung sowie ergänzende Zusatzleistungen

Connectima ist eine spezialisierte Personalberatung, Headhunter und Executive-Search-Partner für Verfahrenstechnik und Filtration. Wir begleiten Fach- und Führungskräfte auf ihrem nächsten Karriereschritt, im DACH-Raum und international, entlang der gesamten Bandbreite dieser Branchen: von Membranfiltration, Prozessfiltration und Wasseraufbereitung über mechanische, chemische und thermische Verfahrenstechnik bis hin zu verfahrenstechnischen Komponenten wie Pumpen, Armaturen, Ventilen und Wärmetauschern. Unser Netzwerk umfasst mehr als 40.000 Fach- und Führungskräfte aus Chemie, Pharma, Maschinenbau und Umwelttechnik. Als reine Branchenspezialisten kennen wir die Unternehmen, Technologien und Entscheidungswege im Detail und beraten Sie persönlich, vertraulich und mit echtem technischem Verständnis.

Most companies are still debating what AI means for design. At TaxDome they've already rebuilt everything around it. This role exists to lead and shape AI native design org.

title: Brand & Creative Designer
description:
We are looking for a visionary designer to elevate and evolve 0G's visual identity. In this role, you will act as the guardian of our brand, translating complex technology into stunning, accessible visuals. You will bridge the gap between product, community, and marketing, ensuring a cohesive narrative across every touchpoint—from high-fidelity UI dashboards to real-time Discord interactions.

Your Mandate:

  • Brand Stewardship: Develop and enforce a comprehensive brand guidelines system, ensuring alignment across all departments and external partners.

  • Asset Production: Produce high-impact marketing collateral (static, motion, and video) that resonates with our Web3-native audience.

  • Product Collaboration: Partner with engineering to design intuitive, visually compelling UI for decentralized applications and analytics dashboards.

  • Community Engagement: Design gamified experiences, competition assets, and interactive social media content that drives retention and hype within our ecosystem.

The Ideal Candidate:

  • Design Foundation: You possess strong graphic design fundamentals—mastery of typography, color theory, and layout—and are proficient in industry-standard tools (Figma, Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects).

  • Fast-Paced & Adaptable: You thrive in high-velocity environments, expertly juggling multiple projects while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines. You synthesize feedback gracefully and iterate with precision.

  • Cross-Functional Translator: You're a natural collaborator who can distill diverse stakeholder requirements into cohesive, engaging designs that serve both product goals and community needs.

  • AI-First Workflow: You leverage AI tools (Midjourney, Runway, Firefly, or equivalent) to expedite ideation, create variations, and enhance video/texture production without sacrificing quality.

  • Video Production Expert: You are proficient in the entire video pipeline—from storyboarding and editing to motion graphics and sound design—capable of producing polished reels, tutorials, and event recaps.

  • [Bonus] Web3 Native: Deep familiarity with the decentralized ecosystem, NFTs, or blockchain culture is a strong plus.

What we offer

title: Chief of Staff
description:
The Role
You'll work directly with the CEO and CFO as their force multiplier — turning executive priorities into organizational execution, keeping the company's most important initiatives moving, and making sure leadership time goes where it matters most. You'll sit at the center of strategy, operations, and finance, with visibility across everything the company does.

What You'll Do

  • Drive strategic initiatives end-to-end — take ambiguous, high-priority mandates from the CEO and CFO and deliver finished outcomes.

  • Run the executive operating rhythm — leadership meetings, planning cycles, OKRs/goals, and follow-through on decisions and action items.

  • Synthesize and brief — distill information from across the company into clear, decision-ready materials for the CEO and CFO.

  • Coordinate across functions — align engineering, product, GTM, and partnerships; identify and resolve cross-team dependencies before they become problems.

  • Support finance and corporate workstreams — partner with the CFO on board, investor, and partner materials: analysis, modeling, and narratives that hold up to institutional scrutiny.

  • Act as a trusted proxy — represent the CEO and CFO in meetings and workstreams, and handle confidential matters with discretion.


What We're Looking For

  • 4+ years in management consulting, investment banking, or an equivalent background (strategy, corporate development, or similar high-rigor roles) — this is a hard requirement.

  • MBA preferred but not required. Structured problem-solver, equally comfortable with financial models, operational processes, and difficult conversations.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication; you make complex things simple.

  • High agency, low ego — you get things done without needing formal authority, and handle sensitive information with discretion.

  • Based in or willing to relocate to Singapore, with flexibility to travel between the three hubs.

What we offer

  • Purpose: The opportunity to contribute to making AI a public good

  • Growth: A self-directed environment where you can take initiative to shape your role and career

title: Head of Product & Engineering (m/w/d)
description:
Intro

Die CKM Group bündelt Expertise aus verschiedenen Bereichen, um Fortschritt und Innovation in der Gesundheitsversorgung voranzutreiben. Unser Zusammenschluss aus Klinik, Labor, telemedizinischem Service und IT-Unternehmen steht für die Entwicklung moderner und effektiver Lösungen im Gesundheitswesen. 
 
Unser Ziel ist es, durch präventive Dienstleistungsmedizin, eHealth und Public Health eine führende und wegweisende Rolle im Gesundheitssystem von morgen einzunehmen. Dabei setzen wir auf smarte Logistik, Digitalisierung, Diagnostik und individuelle Prävention. Wir denken Gesundheitsversorgung und Diagnostik neu und hinterfragen dazu stets den Status Quo. 
 
Ein neuer Pfeiler dieser Vision ist GreenMedical: Mit unserem telemedizinischen Service bieten wir einen einfachen und sicheren Zugang zu medizinischem Cannabis, um Symptome zu lindern und die Lebensqualität zu verbessern. Darüber hinaus unterstützen wir Patienten bereits heute mit modernen Lösungen zur medizinisch begleiteten Gewichtsreduktion. Perspektivisch planen wir, unser Angebot um weitere Präventions- und Gesundheitsleistungen zu erweitern, um noch mehr Menschen individuell auf ihrem Weg zu mehr Gesundheit und Lebensqualität zu begleiten. 

Du möchtest nicht nur Teams führen, sondern eine gesamte Product- und Engineering-Organisation auf das nächste Level bringen? Du verstehst es, technische Exzellenz mit einer klaren Produktstrategie zu verbinden und schaffst Strukturen, die schnelles Wachstum ermöglichen? Dann werde Teil unseres Führungsteams und gestalte die Zukunft unserer Engineering- und Produktorganisation aktiv mit.


Deine Mission bei uns

  • Engineering-Organisation neu aufstellen und skalieren: Du übernimmst die Gesamtverantwortung für drei Engineering-Teams und ein Infrastruktur-Team, strukturierst Organisation, Rollen und Zusammenarbeit neu und baust Strukturen, die mit unserem Wachstum skalieren.
  • Produktteam führen: Du leitest unser Product- und UI/UX-Team, entwickelst Produktstrategie und Roadmap gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung weiter und stellst sicher, dass die wichtigsten Themen zur richtigen Zeit umgesetzt werden - mit dem klaren Ziel, messbares Produktwachstum zu treiben.

description:
Wir bei Knuddels haben uns das Ziel gesetzt, soziale Netzwerke wieder wirklich sozial zu machen - mit echter menschlicher Nähe statt bloßen Content-Konsums. title: Call for offers: Responsible Sourcing Initiative Technical Support (Consultant)
description:
Project Background:

Margins 2 Markets (M2M) is building key components of an effective waste management system in three ecologically valuable coastal regions: Raja Ampat/Sorong (Indonesia), Tamil Nadu (India), and Zanzibar (Tanzania). These regions face similar challenges: remote and growing coastal communities, insufficient waste management infrastructure, limited access to recycling markets, and increasing plastic pollution from tourism and population growth, driving marine litter and threatening biodiversity, fisheries, and local livelihoods.

The project establishes regional collection, pre-processing, and recycling infrastructure, including Material Recovery Facilities (MRFs) and pre-processing sites, and connects these to national and international recycling markets. It combines this physical infrastructure with digital traceability systems, incentive schemes for waste collectors, training, occupational health and safety measures, and transparent payment systems. The overarching goal is to prevent approximately 40,000 tonnes of plastic waste from entering coastal and marine ecosystems and to develop a replicable model for other coastal regions.

Key infrastructure includes:

  • A regional MRF in Ramanathapuram, Tamil Nadu, cleaning, sorting, and baling fishing nets and marine plastics, alongside collection activities across 14 coastal districts.
  • Pre-processing facilities near Kendwa and Paje (Zanzibar) plus a central MRF between Zanzibar City and the landfill.
  • Local collection and pre-processing sites across the Raja Ampat islands, linked to a central facility in Sorong.

Work Package 3

“Create Sustainable Jobs and Support Financial Inclusion,” requires that CleanHub's social standards and project safeguards be assessed against the Responsible Sourcing Initiative Harmonized Framework, with any gaps addressed through training and capacity building for CleanHub country teams and implementing partners in each of the three target regions.

What we are looking for:

Clean Hub is looking for a consultant to align the Margins to Markets (M2M) programme's social standards and safeguards with the Responsible Sourcing Initiative (RSI) Harmonized Framework, and to deliver the related training and workshop support under Work Package 3 of the programme.

Tasks

The scope below reflects the three activity areas already defined for this engagement under WP3. No activities have been added beyond what is required to deliver them.

Work Package 3.1 Gap Assessment Against the RSI Harmonized Framework

  • Review CleanHub's social standards and project safeguards against the RSI Harmonized Framework and identify gaps, differences and priority areas of engagement
  • Develop a work plan for training and capacity building, combining tools (including iWrc videos), Training of Trainers

title: Call for Offers: Technical Waste Management Expert (Consultant)
description:
Project Background:

Margins 2 Markets (M2M) is building key components of an effective waste management system in three ecologically valuable coastal regions: Raja Ampat/Sorong (Indonesia), Tamil Nadu (India), and Zanzibar (Tanzania). These regions face similar challenges: remote and growing coastal communities, insufficient waste management infrastructure, limited access to recycling markets, and increasing plastic pollution from tourism and population growth, driving marine litter and threatening biodiversity, fisheries, and local livelihoods.

The project establishes regional collection, pre-processing, and recycling infrastructure, including Material Recovery Facilities (MRFs) and pre-processing sites, and connects these to national and international recycling markets. It combines this physical infrastructure with digital traceability systems, incentive schemes for waste collectors, training, occupational health and safety measures, and transparent payment systems. The overarching goal is to prevent approximately 40,000 tonnes of plastic waste from entering coastal and marine ecosystems and to develop a replicable model for other coastal regions.

Key infrastructure includes:

  • A regional MRF in Ramanathapuram, Tamil Nadu, cleaning, sorting, and baling fishing nets and marine plastics, alongside collection activities across 14 coastal districts.
  • Pre-processing facilities near Kendwa and Paje (Zanzibar) plus a central MRF between Zanzibar City and the landfill.
  • Local collection and pre-processing sites across the Raja Ampat islands, linked to a central facility in Sorong.

What are we looking for:

CleanHub GmbH is looking for a Technical Waste Management Expert to provide continuous, cross-site technical operational and economical support throughout the project. The consultant will help optimize technical operational and economical concepts for collection, pre-processing, and recycling operations, and support the practical implementation and operational ramp-up of the MRFs and pre-processing facilities across the three countries.

Tasks

The consultant is expected to provide ongoing, as-needed support across the following areas, in coordination with the CleanHub project team and local partners:

Technical concept review and optimization

  • Review and advise on facility layouts, process flows, and equipment specifications for MRFs and pre-processing sites.
  • Recommend improvements to sorting, baling, and material-densification processes to increase material value and reduce transport costs.
  • Advise on capacity planning relative to expected waste volumes and collection growth.

Implementation support

  • Support technical due diligence during facility set-up
  • Review technical documentation, tenders, or equipment specifications from local contractors/suppliers.

title: Senior Spacecraft Systems Engineer – Avionics & Electrical Systems (m/f/d)
description:
Deine Mission

As part of our Avionics & Software team in Munich, you will help define and mature the avionics and electrical systems of our spacecraft platforms. You will translate mission and spacecraft-level needs into clear requirements, interfaces and equipment decisions. Working closely with our Systems Architects and specialist teams in electronics, embedded software and controls, you will ensure that avionics equipment and subsystems form a coherent and verifiable overall system. This is a systems engineering role with a strong technical focus. You are not expected to be the implementation expert for every avionics domain.

Your role will include

  • Define, manage and maintain spacecraft avionics and electrical system requirements.
  • Coordinate interfaces between spacecraft equipment, electronics, embedded software, control systems and higher-level spacecraft functions.
  • Support avionics architecture development together with Systems Architects and technical specialists.
  • Perform and document equipment and make-or-buy trade studies, for example for OBCs, PCDUs, solar arrays, sensors, communication equipment and remote I/O.
  • Translate selected equipment into clear electrical, data and software interface requirements.
  • Develop and maintain interface control documents, architecture descriptions and verification concepts.
  • Coordinate technical topics with suppliers and assess compliance, development status, risks and open points.
  • Support proposal activities through requirements analysis, preliminary architectures, supplier inputs, effort estimates and technical risk assessments.
  • Support subsystem and spacecraft-level integration, verification and troubleshooting.
  • Contribute to MBSE models and continuously improve our systems engineering processes.


Dein Profil

  • Several years of experience in spacecraft avionics, electrical systems or a comparable safety-critical engineering environment.
  • Experience in requirements engineering, interface definition and technical trade studies.
  • Broad understanding of spacecraft avionics and electrical equipment, without the expectation of being a specialist in every domain.
  • Ability to work effectively with electronics, software, controls and systems engineering teams.
  • Experience working with suppliers and evaluating technical proposals or equipment.
  • Familiarity with verification planning, integration testing and relevant systems engineering standards such as ECSS.
  • Strong analytical and communication skills, with a structured and accountable way of working.
  • Motivation to develop systems for space logistics and orbital servicing.

Nice to have
  • Experience with spacecraft power systems, data handling, sensors or communication equipment.
  • Experience with MBSE too

Siena is the Agent of Record for consumer brands. One agent that owns the entire customer journey, running on a shared intelligence layer no point tool can replicate.

Consumer brands run ten or more disconnected tools to manage their customers. We collapse that stack into a single agent. title: Gestaltungsberatung I Manager I Steuerberater (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Rolle

Die Vogel-Gruppe konsolidiert den deutschen Steuerberatungsmarkt — mit dem Ziel, bis 2030 die führende Beratungsplattform für den Mittelstand aufzubauen. Steuerberatung ist dabei nicht ein Geschäftsfeld unter vielen, sondern der Kern: 60 Jahre Substanz, bestehende Mandate über mehrere Generationen, ein neuer Standort im Aufbau in München. Diese Stelle ist Teil dieses Aufbaus und gleichzeitig Antwort auf die Frage, was Steuerberatung sein kann, wenn sie nicht in der Pyramidenstruktur einer Big-Four-Praxis und nicht in der Beliebigkeit einer klassischen Mittelstandskanzlei stattfindet.

Du bist Steuerberater oder kurz vor dem Examen. Du hast nach deinem Examen ein bis drei Jahre Erfahrung gesammelt — bei einer Big Four, einer Next-6-Kanzlei oder einer fokussierten Mittelstands-Praxis. Du übernimmst ab Tag eins einen bestehenden Mandantenkreis aus dem Vogel-Portfolio, entwickelst diesen weiter und unterstützt aktiv beim Aufbau neuer Mandate aus unserer Akquise-Pipeline. Dein Arbeitsort ist unser neuer Standort in München — komplett vor Ort, keine Remote- oder Hybrid-Option. Genau das ist Teil des Designs: Du wirkst am Aufbau dieses Standorts aktiv mit und hast von Anfang an deutliche Gestaltungsfreiheiten — bei Prozessen, Tools, Mandantenarchitektur und Teamaufbau. Du berichtest direkt an die Geschäftsführung der Vogel-Gruppe — keine Senior-Strukturen dazwischen, kurzer und direkter Berichtsweg — und baust mittelfristig eine eigene Associate-Schicht unter dir auf.

Deine Verantwortung

Mandantenführung

  • Übernimm einen bestehenden Mandantenkreis aus dem Vogel-Portfolio und betreue ihn eigenverantwortlich — Jahresabschlüsse, Steuererklärungen, laufende Beratung.

  • Sei direkter Ansprechpartner für Inhaber und Geschäftsführer mittelständischer Unternehmen. Ein Gespräch auf Augenhöhe ist der Standard, nicht die Ausnahme.

  • Entwickle deinen Mandantenkreis aktiv weiter — Erweiterung der Mandate, Cross-Sell in den Vogel-Verbund (Gestaltungen, FP&A, M&A-Vorbereitung).

Mandantenakquise

  • Unterstütze die Akquise neuer Mandate gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung und dem Business-Development-Team — Erstgespräche, fachliche Einschätzung, Übergabe in die laufende Betreuung.

  • Bringe eigene Netzwerk-Aktivität ein — Branchenveranstaltungen, Verbände, lokale Multiplier.

  • Übernimm Lead-Pipeline aus unserem Buy-&-Build-Funnel, sobald Mandate über akquirierte Kanzleien zu uns wechseln.

Team-Aufbau

  • Baue über die nächsten zwölf bis 24 Mo

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager

description:
Alter Schwede, wir suchen Dich!
Wieso mich?
Na klar – da steht’s doch: Nettes Team sucht sympathische Unterstützung.
Das bist doch Du!

Das Beste daran:
Du arbeitest bequem von Zuhause.
Heißt: kein Pendeln, keine Fahrtkosten, kein Stress.
Dafür volle Freiheit – Du richtest Dir Deinen Arbeitsplatz so ein, wie Du magst. Jogginghose? Kein Problem.

Und jetzt kommt’s:
Du pratar svenska med kunderna!

Aufgaben

Du nimmst Anrufe von schwedischen Kunden entgegen und bearbeitest Bestellungen – also ein ganz entspannter Job mit nettem Kontakt.

„Lagom är bäst“ – das Maßvolle ist das Beste.
Genau das leben wir auch im Team: freundlich, gelassen, hilfsbereit.

Klingt gut? Dann komm zu uns und werde Teil unseres Teams.
Wir freuen uns auf Dich!

Die Einarbeitung erfolgt auch im Home-Office und die Technik wird gestellt. Voraussetzung ist eine stabile Internetleitung, sowie ein Arbeitsplatz der den Datenschutzverordnungen entspricht.

Qualifikation

Sehr gute Deutsch- und Schwedischkenntnisse sowie leichte Computerkenntnisse sollten vorhanden sein.
Auch Queereinsteiger sind herzlich willkommen und werden selbstverständlich eingearbeitet.

Wichtig ist, dass Du gute Laune hast und gerne von netten Menschen umgeben bist!

Fun Fact:
Die Redewendung „Alter Schwede!“ stammt übrigens gar nicht aus Schweden, sondern aus dem Dreißigjährigen Krieg (1618–1648). Damals holte der preußische König Friedrich Wilhelm erfahrene schwedische Soldaten, um sein Heer zu schulen.
Diese galten als besonders tüchtig – und so blieb der Ausdruck „Alter Schwede!“ bis heute als respektvolle Anerkennung erhalten.

Bewirb dich jetzt.

title: Language Lead - French (Contract)
description:
About Cartesia

Our mission is to architect AI that learns from and interacts with the world like humans do.

We're pioneering the model architectures that will make this possible. Our founding team met as PhDs at the Stanford AI Lab, where we invented State Space Models or SSMs, a new primitive for training efficient, large-scale foundation models. Our team combines deep expertise in model innovation and systems engineering paired with a design-minded product engineering team to build and ship cutting edge models and experiences.

We're funded by leading investors at Index Ventures and Lightspeed Venture Partners, along with Factory, Conviction, A Star, General Catalyst, SV Angel, Databricks and others. We're fortunate to have the support of many amazing advisors, and 90+ angels across many industries, including the world's foremost experts in AI.

Overview

We are seeking native-level French speakers with a linguistics background to serve as the primary language resource for voice AI in their language. You will be the trusted point of contact for all questions, quality decisions, and language-specific work related to French.

This is not a standard annotation engagement. You will own your language end to end, which includes managing annotation quality, auditing data, monitoring product performance, investigating customer-reported issues, and executing projects that require deep linguistic expertise and attention to detail. You will operate independently across these workstreams and serve as the team's go-to resource for anything related to your language.

This is an ongoing contractor engagement. Availability during some US Pacific business hours is preferred to allow for team syncs and real-time support.

 

About the Engagement

You will coordinate with the Human Evals Manager on project deliverables and timelines. Some examples of what your day-to-day work may include:

  • Answer questions from annotators about guidelines, edge cases, or language-specific issues via an agreed project communication channel.

  • Cascade new feedback, instructions, or rubric updates to annotators working on your projects.

  • Listen to annotator-rated audio files and check whether their ratings and written feedback align with the rubric.

  • Prepare written quality assessments for annotators with specific examples and recommendations.

  • Listen to TTS output and provide ground truth assessmen

As our Senior Account Manager DACH, you'll own and grow a focused portfolio of our most strategic and high-value accounts across the DACH region. At Lokalise, we make it easy and profitable for businesses to expand into new markets. Our AI-powered localization platform helps companies manage both software and marketing content from a single, unified environment — ensuring every team speaks with one voice across every language and channel.

By automating workflows, integrating with over 60 tools, and centralizing translation memory and terminology, Lokalise enables product, engineering, and marketing teams to collaborate without friction and launch globally up to 10× faster and at 80% lower cost.

Backed by a customer-loved support team, our platform fits seamlessly into your design, development, and content workflows, helping you scale with consistency and control.

Location

While our company operates exclusively on a remote basis, you must reside and have the legal right to work in one of the following countries: the United Kingdom, Latvia, or Spain.

description:
Deine Rolle

Die Vogel-Gruppe konsolidiert den deutschen Steuerberatungsmarkt — mit dem Ziel, bis 2030 die führende Beratungsplattform für den Mittelstand aufzubauen. Steuerberatung ist dabei nicht ein Geschäftsfeld unter vielen, sondern der Kern: 60 Jahre Substanz, bestehende Mandate über mehrere Generationen, ein neuer Standort im Aufbau in München. Diese Stelle ist Teil dieses Aufbaus und gleichzeitig Antwort auf die Frage, was Steuerberatung sein kann, wenn sie nicht in der Pyramidenstruktur einer Big-Four-Praxis und nicht in der Beliebigkeit einer klassischen Mittelstandskanzlei stattfindet.

Du bist Steuerberater oder kurz vor dem Examen. Du hast nach deinem Examen ein bis drei Jahre Erfahrung gesammelt — bei einer Big Four, einer Next-6-Kanzlei oder einer fokussierten Mittelstands-Praxis. Du übernimmst ab Tag eins einen bestehenden Mandantenkreis aus dem Vogel-Portfolio, entwickelst diesen weiter und unterstützt aktiv beim Aufbau neuer Mandate aus unserer Akquise-Pipeline. Dein Arbeitsort ist unser neuer Standort in München — komplett vor Ort, keine Remote- oder Hybrid-Option. Genau das ist Teil des Designs: Du wirkst am Aufbau dieses Standorts aktiv mit und hast von Anfang an deutliche Gestaltungsfreiheiten — bei Prozessen, Tools, Mandantenarchitektur und Teamaufbau. Du berichtest direkt an die Geschäftsführung der Vogel-Gruppe — keine Senior-Strukturen dazwischen, kurzer und direkter Berichtsweg — und baust mittelfristig eine eigene Associate-Schicht unter dir auf.

Mandantenführung

  • Übernimm einen bestehenden Mandantenkreis aus dem Vogel-Portfolio und betreue ihn eigenverantwortlich — Jahresabschlüsse, Steuererklärungen, laufende Beratung.

  • Entwickle deinen Mandantenkreis aktiv weiter — Erweiterung der Mandate, Cross-Sell in den Vogel-Verbund (Gestaltungen, FP&A, M&A-Vorbereitung).

  • Unterstütze die Akquise neuer Mandate gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung und dem Business-Development-Team — Erstgespräche, fachliche Einschätzung, Übergabe in die laufende Betreuung.

  • Bringe eigene Netzwerk-Aktivität ein — Branchenveranstaltungen, Verbände, lokale Multiplier.

  • Übernimm Lead-Pipeline aus unserem Buy-&-Build-Funnel, sobald Mandate über akquirierte Kanzleien zu uns wechseln.

title: Werkstudent Planungsrecht & Research (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Mission

Die Software von syte hilft Entwickler*innen, Planer*innen und Investor*innen dabei, komplexe Entscheidungen rund um Immobilienprojekte zu treffen. Jetzt bauen wir eine KI-Suche, die für jedes Grundstück in Deutschland herausfindet, welches Planungsrecht dort gilt: Bebauungsplan, Flächennutzungsplan, Erhaltungssatzung – alles, was zwischen einer Idee und einem genehmigungsfähigen Projekt steht.

Als Werkstudent Planungsrecht & Research (m/w/d) unterstützt du ab dem 01.09.2026 das Product Team dabei, unseren KI-Agenten zu perfektionieren. Mit deiner Expertise im Planungs- und Baurecht prüfst du reale Grundstücke und entwickelst daraus den fachlichen Maßstab, an dem sich unsere KI messen lassen muss.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Planungsrechtliche Recherche und Einordnung: Du verantwortest die inhaltliche Substanz des Datensatzes. Für reale Grundstücke ermittelst du, welche planungsrechtlichen Dokumente dort tatsächlich greifen: Bebauungspläne, Flächennutzungspläne, Erhaltungs- undGestaltungssatzungen und was in der jeweiligen Kommune sonst noch gilt. Dazu die Einordnung nach §§ 30, 34 oder 35 BauGB.
  • Analyse und Struktur: Du analysierst und strukturierst vorhandene und neue Grundstücksfälle und findest belastbare Bewertungsregeln. Diese Arbeit bildet die Grundlage für ein Bewertungsraster, welches wir gemeinsam aufsetzen.
  • Nachweisführung und Datenqualität: Du schaffst eine Datenbank mit allen neuen Recherchen inkl. Quellen und archivierten Dokumenten, damit Rückfragen schnell nachvollzogen werden können.
  • Evaluation und Rückkopplung ins Produkt: Sobald der Datensatz trägt, wird er zum Messinstrument. Du prüfst KI-Antworten gegen deine Recherchen, ordnest Abweichungen ein und erkennst darin Muster statt Einzelfälle. About Oper

Oper, a European Fintech company, is a leader in cloud-based digital mortgage software. We provide personalized journeys for borrowers and lenders. Oper's technology streamlines the mortgage application process, eliminates paperwork, and increases transparency.

The fastest growing part of our business is Herman, our AI agent for mortgage origination. Herman reads documents, checks them, and works a credit file the way an analyst would, inside the regulated workflow of a real bank. It runs on sovereign EU infrastructure, because our clients cannot send mortgage data anywhere else. Phase by phase, it automates more of the origination process: first employed borrowers, then the self-employed, and onward. This is not a chatbot bolted onto old software. Fanvue is one of the fastest-growing creator monetisation platforms globally. We're an AI-powered, creator-first platform helping creators connect, engage, and earn directly from their audiences at scale. Following our recent Series A, Fanvue has surpassed $100M+ in annual recurring revenue, with triple-digit year-on-year growth, supporting hundreds of thousands of creators and millions of fans worldwide.

Money moves through Fanvue in three directions every day: fans paying in, acquirers settling to our banks, and creators being paid out what they have earned. At our scale, across a multi-acquirer stack and multiple currencies, proving that all of it happened correctly is a discipline in its own right. That is what this role owns.

🎯 The Role

We're hiring a Payments & Treasury Analyst to own continuous reconciliation of money movement across the platform, reporting directly to our VP Finance with a dotted line into Operations.

This is a Finance controls role. Operations runs the payment rails. You prove the money moved, every day, independently. The distinction matters and it is the whole point of the job.

Today reconciliation happens periodically. Your job is to make it constant and owned. We are building the ledger and matching tooling in parallel, so the mechanical matching will be automated. What automation cannot do is own the exceptions daily and apply payments judgement: reading an acquirer statement and spotting a fee that does not match the agreement, or knowing whether a settlement gap is a weekend cycle or a genuine break. That judgement is why this is a specialist hire rather than generalist finance headcount.

You will be doing live reconciliation work from week one. There is no synthetic onboarding period.

🚀 What You'll Do

  • Own the daily acquirer to bank reconciliation across our full acquirer estate

  • Stand up and run independent daily monitoring of creator payouts against earnings owed, so no payout moves without reconciliation behind it

  • Publish a weekly reconciled percentage per leg to Finance, and keep an exceptions queue that gets worked rather than just logged

  • Validate acquirer fees against every merchant services agreement and recover variances

  • Map FX exposure across settlement vendors and optimise cash held

title: Senior Spacecraft Systems Engineer – Avionics & Electrical Systems (m/f/d)
description:
Deine Mission

As part of our Avionics & Software team in Munich, you will help define and mature the avionics and electrical systems of our spacecraft platforms. You will translate mission and spacecraft-level needs into clear requirements, interfaces and equipment decisions. Working closely with our Systems Architects and specialist teams in electronics, embedded software and controls, you will ensure that avionics equipment and subsystems form a coherent and verifiable overall system. This is a systems engineering role with a strong technical focus. You are not expected to be the implementation expert for every avionics domain.

Your role will include

  • Define, manage and maintain spacecraft avionics and electrical system requirements.
  • Coordinate interfaces between spacecraft equipment, electronics, embedded software, control systems and higher-level spacecraft functions.
  • Support avionics architecture development together with Systems Architects and technical specialists.
  • Perform and document equipment and make-or-buy trade studies, for example for OBCs, PCDUs, solar arrays, sensors, communication equipment and remote I/O.
  • Translate selected equipment into clear electrical, data and software interface requirements.
  • Develop and maintain interface control documents, architecture descriptions and verification concepts.
  • Coordinate technical topics with suppliers and assess compliance, development status, risks and open points.
  • Support proposal activities through requirements analysis, preliminary architectures, supplier inputs, effort estimates and technical risk assessments.
  • Support subsystem and spacecraft-level integration, verification and troubleshooting.
  • Contribute to MBSE models and continuously improve our systems engineering processes.


Dein Profil

  • Several years of experience in spacecraft avionics, electrical systems or a comparable safety-critical engineering environment.
  • Experience in requirements engineering, interface definition and technical trade studies.
  • Broad understanding of spacecraft avionics and electrical equipment, without the expectation of being a specialist in every domain.
  • Ability to work effectively with electronics, software, controls and systems engineering teams.
  • Experience working with suppliers and evaluating technical proposals or equipment.
  • Familiarity with verification planning, integration testing and relevant systems engineering standards such as ECSS.
  • Strong analytical and communication skills, with a structured and accountable way of working.
  • Motivation to develop systems for space logistics and orbital servicing.

Nice to have
  • Experience with spacecraft power systems, data handling, sensors or communication equipment.
  • Experience with MBSE too

title: Staff Product Designer, Enterprise Products
description:
We're building a new global Berlitz, and this is your opportunity to help shape it. Nearly 150 years of expertise, meeting the ambition and technology to power a new era of learning.

If you are the kind of person who thrives in a fast-paced environment, isn’t afraid of a blank page, and is excited to help shape the future of a global company undergoing a significant transformation, you might belong at Berlitz!

A lot of our customers today are enterprise HR and L&D teams, but we haven't given those teams a great way to run what they've bought from us, report on it, and track the value. That gap costs us deals and renewals. We're building our Enterprise customer platform to close that gap. The control center that HR and L&D teams use to manage learners, connect their existing LMS and HR systems, track engagement and CEFR progress, and prove Berlitz's ROI to their own leadership. You'll work as an equal partner alongside Product Management and Engineering, and you'll be the first dedicated design hire on this product, so the standards, patterns, and process you set will shape how the team designs enterprise software at Berlitz for years to come.

Your responsibilities

  • Design our Enterprise customer platform end to end, from a mostly blank slate: user management, LMS and HRIS integrations, SSO and provisioning, reporting and ROI dashboards, and the invoicing and admin workflows enterprise buyers expect.

  • Conduct a lot of customer research. Understand deeply our buyer personas, their jobs to be done, their pain points, and their buying triggers. Talk directly and often with HR directors, L&D managers, and procurement teams to build real empathy for people who touch the product a few times a month, not every day.

  • Design for two distinct users in one product: the L&D Manager who needs fast, frequent, operational tools, and the Global HR Director who needs a clear, summarized view of impact across regions.

  • Build within Berlitz's shared design system while extending it with the patterns a data-heavy, enterprise admin product needs.

  • Help set the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Enterprise Products, balancing what buyers ask for

title: Football Tracking Systems Operator (RoC)
description:
Location: Basingstoke, Hampshire. This is an in-office role, and as such, will require you to live within a reasonable commute.

Contract: Casual hourly contract

Working Hours: Shifts typically 10 - 12 hours

Hourly Rate: £13.00 - £18.20 Per Hour (exact rate will vary depending on role)

Start Date: July/August 2026

Why Hawk-Eye & Why This Role?:

We are looking for candidates to play a key part in delivering Goal Line Technology (GLT) at our centre in Basingstoke; however, there is scope for successful candidates to be offered further opportunities in delivering Electronic Performance and Tracking Systems (EPTS) and Semi-Automatic Offside (SAO) in elite football competitions. Having successfully deployed this system across UEFA competitions, we are now expanding our remote operations to include the Premier League and Championship.


Based in the Remote Operations Centre (ROC) at Hawk-Eye’s Head Office in Basingstoke, you'll play a crucial role in operating cutting-edge technology, liaising with Hawk-Eye colleagues on the ground across the UK, and a range of external stakeholders, contributing to the excitement of live sports events.

While this is a casual contract, we are seeking candidates with full availability across the week. This role is designed for those looking to commit to significant hours, particularly during peak periods of the football calendar.

What Does A Typical Day Look Like?

For a typical 3pm kick off you can expect our call time to be 5 to 6 hours prior to the start of the match. Throughout the day you will be faced with several hard deadlines in which you will have to meet in order for the service to run effectively and efficiently.

Initially, you will spend the first part of your day testing communications, calibrating, and optimising the technology. This ensures GLT is fully operational two hours prior to kick-off, allowing match officials to test its integrity.

Warm up is our final opportunity to ensure the system is fully functional before we enter the live match. During the live match you will be monitoring the data, fine tuning the calibration and constantly preparing to produce a virtual replay for broadcasters should a goal line incident occur and activate our GLT system.

title: Remote Pharmacist
description:
Looking for a pharmacist role where you can focus on clinical checking without being tied to a physical pharmacy?

We are looking for a GPhC registered Pharmacist to join Montu UK on a fully remote, fixed-term contract, supporting the clinical checking of prescriptions for our growing patient community.

This is a focused, high-volume role for someone who enjoys working accurately at pace, is confident making clinical decisions and is comfortable working independently in a digital environment.

You will play an important part in keeping prescriptions moving safely and efficiently, identifying anything that needs further intervention and working with our wider pharmacy and clinical teams to resolve issues quickly.

If you are an experienced pharmacist looking for a fully remote opportunity where you can use your clinical expertise and make a genuine difference to the patient journey, we would love to hear from you.

What is the job?

Behind every prescription we dispense is a clinical check that helps ensure our patients receive their medication safely, accurately and without unnecessary delay.

As Montu continues to grow, we are looking for a Pharmacist to join our pharmacy team on a fully remote, fixed-term basis, focusing on the clinical checking of prescriptions through our online pharmacy platform.

This is a high-volume role where you will be responsible for reviewing prescriptions for clinical appropriateness and accuracy, identifying anything that requires intervention and working closely with our pharmacy and clinical teams to resolve issues quickly.

You will need to be confident working independently, comfortable working to clear productivity and quality expectations and able to maintain excellent clinical standards while managing a consistent volume of prescriptions.

This is a great opportunity for a pharmacist who enjoys focused clinical work, works well in a fast-moving digital environment and wants to play an important part in keeping our patients' treatment moving safely and efficiently.

What will you be doing?

You will be responsible for clinically checking prescriptions through Montu's online pharmacy system, ensuring they meet professional, clinical and regulatory requirements before progressing through the dispensing process.

You will:

  • Clinically check prescriptions accurately and efficiently using our online pharmacy platform.

  • Ensure prescriptions are reviewed and progressed within agreed SLAs and turnaround times.<

Ob das funktioniert, sagen unsere Kundinnen und Kunden besser als jede Anzeige: 4,94 von 5 Sternen bei über 3.500 Bewertungen. Dazu kommen Nachrichten, für die man sich Zeit nehmen muss — seitenlang, und erstaunlich oft steht darin das Wort „lebensverändernd". Menschen, die ihren Zuckerkonsum umgestellt haben und uns erzählen, was sich dadurch für sie verändert hat.

Genau da setzt diese Rolle an. Wer sich für weniger Zucker entscheidet, entscheidet sich nicht einmal — sondern jeden Tag neu. Wir wollen unsere Kundinnen und Kunden auf diesem Weg begleiten: mit E-Mails und Nachrichten, die zum richtigen Zeitpunkt kommen, die weiterhelfen statt nur zu verkaufen, und die aus einer guten Entscheidung eine Gewohnheit machen. Dafür suchen wir dich.

Deine Mission
Du machst aus Erstkäufern Stammkunden. Du verantwortest unser CRM — Flows, Kampagnen, Segmentierung — baust WhatsApp als neuen Kanal von Grund auf auf und entwickelst unser Treue- und Referral-Programm. Deine Nordstern-Metrik: die Wiederkaufrate.

Ausgangslage
Es gibt bei NaschNatur bisher kein CRM-Team, keine Agentur und keine gewachsene Struktur. Klaviyo läuft, erste Flows stehen — der Rest ist offen. Du bist die erste Person, die diesen Bereich verantwortet und ihn von hier aus aufbaut.
Das heißt in den ersten Monaten: Du machst fast alles selbst. Flows bauen, Segmente anlegen, Kampagnen einplanen, WhatsApp-Setup aufsetzen, Reportings ziehen, Tools evaluieren. Es gibt niemanden, an den du Umsetzung abgeben kannst. Hands-on ist in dieser Rolle keine Floskel, sondern die Arbeitsbeschreibung — die Strategie entsteht beim Bauen, nicht davor.

Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest unser E-Mail-Marketing in Klaviyo end-to-end: Flows (Welcome, Post-Purchase, Win-Back), Kampagnen, Segmentierung, A/B-Tests, Deliverability
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserer Gründerin Andi zusammen: Sie schreibt die Texte für unsere Mails, du machst daraus Kampagnen und Flows, die zur richtigen Zeit bei den richtigen Menschen landen — inklusive Kalender, Briefings und Freigabeprozess
  • Du baust unseren WhatsApp-Kanal auf: Opt-in-Strecken, Automationen, Kanalstrategie — und verzahnst ihn sauber mit der E-Mail statt ihn danebenzustellen
  • Du entwickelst und betreibst unser Treueprogramm und unser Referral-Programm
  • Du baust unsere Lifecycle-Logik über alle Kanäle: Wer bekommt wann welche Botschaft — und wer bewusst keine
  • Du arbeitest datenbasiert: Kohorten, Wiederkaufraten, Lifecycle-Analysen — und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab<

title: Engineering Supervisor /  Safety Technology Implementation Lead
description:
Are you an experienced railway professional with knowledge and experience of roles like COSS, ES and PICOP?

You already understand the track and the people who work on it. We're looking for people like you to help put new safety technology into the hands of the workforce - and to be part of a big change in how track workers are kept safe.

At Tended, we create first-of-a-kind safety systems that transform rail worker safety. Our geofencing solution has been named one of TIME's Best Inventions and has made the Digital Leaders 100 list for Geospatial Initiative of the Year. It's already out there on the track, helping to keep people away from the running line and improving on site efficiency.

Network Rail is committed to geofencing for the long term, and the rollout across the Sussex region is already underway. We're looking for an Implementation Lead to help us grow our capability on the ground.

Tasks

As an Implementation Lead, you're the bridge between Tended and our clients, guiding their teams through helping their teams get comfortable using our kit out on-site.

You'll lead key client deployments on the ground, working closely with Tended's project managers to deliver an excellent service. Success in this role depends on building strong, trusting relationships quickly - so first-class communication and interpersonal skills are essential.

Our technology is used by track workers with a wide range of technical confidence. You'll develop a deep understanding of our products so you can coach users through their day-to-day challenges and until they’re confident using it on their own. Being on-site also puts you in a unique position to see how our products are really used - spotting ideas for how we can make it better and feeding improvements back to the team.

You'll need strong knowledge of the rail environment and the roles within it, and you'll either hold a Personal Track Safety (PTS) qualification or meet the requirements to obtain one. Above all, we're looking for someone proactive and approachable - person fit matters to us.**

Travel and working pattern

This is a field-based role centred on regular client site visits across the Sussex region. You'll spend at least 3 days a week in the depot and on site, with the remaining time working remotely or in person with your line manager.

Because our users work shifts, this role covers both nightshifts and dayshifts, and includes weekend and bank holiday working - flexibility to meet the needs of the business and our clients is essential.

In return, we have excellent policies covering travel, accommodation and subsistence expenses, as well as fatigue management and time off in lieu.

A full driving licence is required.

title: Senior Demand Generation Manager - EU/UK
description:
Marqeta is seeking a high-energy Senior Demand Generation Manager to lead demand generation strategy across our global sales segments, spanning North America and EMEA. In this strategic role, you'll set the direction for integrated campaigns that generate qualified pipeline for our commercial and enterprise sales teams worldwide as well as building integrated campaigns within our B2B Enterprise marketing funnel.

You'll work closely with sales leadership, product marketing, marketing operations, and external media partners to design and run full-funnel programs across events, paid media, SEO/AEO, and outbound campaigns, primarily within our Named Account List segments. The ideal candidate knows how to build demand strategies for enterprise accounts that flex across regional and country-level nuances, activate prospect data and campaign insights across the funnel, and coach a growing team to deliver on shared pipeline goals.

PLEASE NOTE: This is a hybrid role and requires employees to be based within 35 miles of our London office. You will be expected to work on-site two days a week, on Tuesday and Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely on the other days.

The Talent team will share more details if selected for the "Recruiter" Interview. We'd love for you to join us!

The Impact You'll Have

  • Own demand generation strategy and performance across global sales segments (North America and EMEA), driving core KPIs: target account engagement, intent progression, and pipeline generation.

  • Directly manage and develop a Demand Generation Manager, setting priorities, reviewing campaign performance, and coaching toward pipeline outcomes.

  • Plan, execute, and optimise integrated demand generation campaigns across regions, adapting programs to country- and segment-level nuances.

  • Own strategy across channels including paid media (Google, LinkedIn, Reddit, programmatic), events, media partnerships, email, SEO/AEO, and outbound prospecting support.

  • Partner very closely with ABM, automation & sales enablement functions to deliver pipeline

  • Serve as a key strategic partner between sales and marketing leadership, translating field insights and campaign data into program-level recommendations.

  • Establish and lead a structured testing agenda across the team, sharing insights that inform broader marketing strategy.

  • Partner with marketing operations to ensure accurate tracking, attribution, and reporting across regions.
